description: How a selected graph read depends on the owner registry `📋️build-owners.json`. The identity of a selected scope (store directory, published graph, admission memo, fleet head, owner checkpoint) is the digest of the selection alone. The registry is never part of an identity: what an owner's inference ASKED of the registry travels in its record as `global` rows (`path` = JSON [name, workspaceRoot, segments], `fact` = JSON of the answer) and holds while the current registry answers the same. A row of the registry that nobody asked about changes no record. The graph and the closure of a scope, which read the registry as a whole, carry one `digest` row.

Question.description: The questions a read may ask. `row`: the digest of the row of one owner name, or null. `package`: the owner that declares one package name, or null. `root`: the owner of one root or native root, or null. `within`: the owner whose root is a directory or its deepest ancestor, never the workspace root, or null. `providers`: the digest of the catalog providers that serve an owner root, [ownerRoot, hasTargets, inputNames]. `candidates`: the digest of the native manifests the owners declare. `wasm-index`: the digest of the compile output index of the owners (registered by the owner discovery). `digest`: the digest of the whole registry.

RowDigest.description: sha256 hex of the JSON array [name, root, manifest, packages sorted by code point, nativeRoots sorted by code point] with no whitespace and no ASCII escaping.

RegistryDigest.description: sha256 hex of the JSON array [[name, RowDigest] ordered by name code point, [[ownerRoot, sourcePath, consumerRoots sorted] ordered by ownerRoot then sourcePath]].
